authorities.rule: Correcting an artifact: append a new row naming the same artifact with its new sha256. Last same-artifact row speaks today; older rows remain history.
T3 requires PASS field entries from real use. trust.json is derived, never manually asserted; ledger append-only.
Missing artifact existence is checked before hash supersession; a later row cannot waive a missing path.
artifact_path tries literal path first, then generated runs.json forwarding.
_earned raises toT3 for any field/PASS label; no real-use validation in that function.
cmd_evidence appends and regenerates trust; missing literal artifact rejected before write. Retraction fields explicitly prohibited.
Established CLI commands are plan/flatten/check for timestamped run evidence; no arbitrary missing-path repair command.
